CVE-2021-46195.description: GCC v12.0 was discovered to contain an uncontrolled recursion via the component libiberty/rust-demangle.c. This vulnerability allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by consuming excessive CPU and memory resources.

CVE-2026-95619.title: A flaw was found in libstdc++. An integer overflow can occur when ...
CVE-2026-95619.description: A flaw was found in libstdc++. An integer overflow can occur when processing large inputs to the C++ `new` operator. This vulnerability could lead to an undersized memory allocation, potentially causing memory corruption or application instability.
